headline: GOLD SINKS $50 AS U.S. STRIKES IRAN — Inflation Fears Kill Rate-Cut Hopes, Silver Drops 2.5%
snippet: Spot gold fell 1.26% to $4,512.50/oz and silver dropped 2.55% to $76.09/oz in early Tuesday trading as U.S. military strikes against targets in southern Iran drove Brent crude sharply higher, stoking inflation fears and pushing back rate-cut timelines — a toxic combination for non-yielding metals.

headline: USAR SURGED 221% IN ONE YEAR — Can USA Rare Earth Make You a Millionaire, or Is It Already Priced In?
snippet: With USA Rare Earth (USAR) shares up 221% in the past year and Stillwater Phase 1a processing now commissioned, The Motley Fool examines whether its $1.6 billion in secured funding and government contracts justify the valuation — or whether retail investors are buying a story Wall Street has already fully priced.

headline: RELIEF RALLY OR DOWNTREND? Analysts Debate Whether $4,500 Gold Holds After Iran Shock
snippet: With gold retreating from $4,560 to below $4,515 on renewed U.S.-Iran conflict, GoldSeek analysts weigh whether this selloff is a healthy correction before the next all-time high — or the start of something deeper, with S&P 500 internals also flashing warning signs that precious metals investors should not ignore.

headline: COPPER HITS $6.36 AND CLIMBING — AI Data Centers and Supply Deficits Fuel 35% Year-Over-Year Surge
snippet: Copper climbed to $6.36/lb on May 26 — up 34.73% year-over-year — as AI data center wiring demand and electrification converge with structural supply deficits; sulfuric acid used in copper extraction has surged 80% year-to-date, squeezing producer margins even at near-record metal prices.

headline: CHINA'S RARE EARTH GRIP TIGHTER THAN OPEC'S — CEO Explains Why Western Supply Chains Can't Break Free
snippet: The CEO of rare earth processor Alloys argues that China's 90%+ control of separated rare earth output — from missile guidance systems to iPhone processors — gives Beijing leverage OPEC could only dream of, and explains why breaking that stranglehold requires a minimum decade of sustained Western investment even with today's government incentives.

headline: GOLCONDA GOLD POSTS RECORD Q1 PRODUCTION, Revenue and Earnings — Galaxy 26 Level Ramping Up
snippet: Golconda Gold delivered record Q1 2026 gold production, revenue, net income, and operating cash flow as the Galaxy 26 Level underground mine adds ore delivery flexibility; the Summit Mine in New Mexico is targeting commissioning by end of Q2 2026, adding a second production centre to the portfolio at a time of near-record gold prices.

headline: SILVER UP 3%, GOLD UP 1.3% — The Gold/Silver Ratio at 58.9 Is Telling You Something Important
snippet: Silver's outperformance on Monday's rally compressed the gold/silver ratio to 58.9 — a historically significant level where industrial and investment demand converge — and GoldSilver.com argues this setup has historically preceded sharp silver outperformance, even accounting for Tuesday's reversal on Iran tensions.
